brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: pieces at level 0 (0,0,0 and 1,0,0) and level 1 (0,0,1 and 1,-1,1) with snap connections and joint bolts
bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full and bin:1,-1,1~hex-bin-full on the upper level (level 1)
notch:0#0,1#notch1 hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm at level 0 between 0,0,0 and 1,0,0
capOpenFaces placed 16 caps covering all open faces; check_build shows no OPEN_CAP_FACE issues and meshClash clear

finish.summary: Workbench organizer built with two storeys (2x base footprint stacked to level 1), two full bins on the top level, a notch drawer on the lower level, and all exposed edges capped and joints locked.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
